source_rule: Repository HEADs were resolved with git ls-remote and inspected at the recorded commit; PyPI versions are the executed identities where present.

candidates.name: pdfplumber
candidates.tests_ci: Repository has a tests directory and GitHub workflow; benchmark behavior executed here.
candidates.egress: None in the tested local-path API.
candidates.basis: Exact on all text-layer rows and controls with ~31-32 MB peak RSS; documented upstream as best on machine-generated PDFs.

candidates.name: Docling
candidates.model_license: docling-layout-heron Apache-2.0 at 8f39ad3c0b4c58e9c2d2c84a38465abf757272d8; docling-models CDLA-Permissive-2.0 at fc0f2d45e2218ea24bce5045f58a389aed16dc23
candidates.tests_ci: Repository has tests/workflows; all four local corpus documents executed.
candidates.egress: First run downloaded model assets from Hugging Face/ModelScope; the retained run set offline flags and installed a fail-closed socket guard before parser imports, with local synthetic paths only.
candidates.basis: Exact on the image-only scan and text corpus, but 1.2-2.11 GB peak RSS and 15-29 s per one-page PDF require a scan-only isolated fallback.

candidates.name: PaddleOCR
candidates.model_license: Model-specific; not resolved because no PaddleOCR model was downloaded or executed.
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes workflows; not executed because Docling closed the evidenced scan gap.
candidates.egress: Local deployment is documented; model download sources include Hugging Face and ModelScope.
candidates.basis: No remaining scan accuracy gap justified a second OCR stack.

candidates.name: Marker
candidates.model_license: Modified AI Pubs OpenRAIL-M; README states commercial conditions above $5M funding/revenue.
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes workflows; desk review only.
candidates.egress: Local inference is supported; optional LLM modes can call Gemini, Vertex, Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or OpenRouter.
candidates.basis: No evidenced extraction gap remained, while model licensing and optional external-service surfaces add review cost.

candidates.name: Pandera
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes CI and tests; valid/invalid source-location checks executed locally.
candidates.egress: None in the tested local DataFrame validation path.
candidates.basis: Useful declarative boundary validation, but adding pandas/Python solely for four checks is unjustified until a Python ingestion owner exists.

candidates.name: RapidFuzz
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes tests/workflows; ambiguous candidate ranking executed locally.
candidates.egress: None in the tested in-process scorer.
candidates.basis: Use only to rank candidates; the executed 87.18 vs 82.93 near-candidates prove similarity cannot establish a financial match.

candidates.name: Open Accountant skills
candidates.tests_ci: No GitHub workflow at the pinned root; each reviewed candidate path contains SKILL.md only, not executable accounting tests.
candidates.egress: Instructions reference Wilson tools and, in one fallback, an online converter; no instruction was executed and no global skill was installed.
candidates.basis: Selected checklist/presentation ideas are reusable only after replacement with governed, read-only tools and receipt-backed totals.

candidates.name: ERPClaw
candidates.code_license: GPL-3.0 per pinned README; LICENSE.txt referenced
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes workflows; claims were not executed.
candidates.egress: Claims local operation but fetches vertical modules on demand and is built around local command execution.
candidates.basis: Decimal amounts, immutable reversing entries and transaction invariants are useful patterns; the mutating ERP is an architecture replacement.

candidates.name: YourFinanceWORKS
candidates.code_license: Split AGPL-3.0 plus commercial source-available directories
candidates.tests_ci: No GitHub workflow path found at the pinned root; desk review only.
candidates.egress: Full stack advertises AI OCR, vision providers, cloud storage, Slack, banking and payment integrations.
candidates.basis: Overlapping multi-tenant platform, mixed licensing, provider surfaces and fraud-language claims conflict with accepted ownership and bounded evidence rules.

candidates.name: ERPNext
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes scheduled server tests; desk review only.
candidates.egress: Self-hosted and managed-hosting options; no execution here.
candidates.basis: Mature accounting and reconciliation domain reference, but a complete Frappe ERP would replace Twenty ownership.

candidates.name: Obsigna
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes multiple workflows and a conformance suite; desk review only.
candidates.egress: Local SDK/proxy patterns available; no execution here.
candidates.basis: Canonical signed-receipt and forward-compatible raw verification patterns may inform existing receipts; do not add a parallel receipt authority.

candidates.name: Nobulex
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes workflows; pinned README marks this repository as a prior direction.
candidates.egress: Integrations span multiple agent frameworks; no execution here.
candidates.basis: Retired direction and trust-score authority overlap existing factory governance without solving Finance extraction.

candidates.name: auditable
candidates.model_license: Optional external model endpoints are caller-selected
candidates.tests_ci: Repository exposes workflows; desk review only.
candidates.egress: Core can run locally; one example optionally calls an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
candidates.basis: Declared/observed dependency provenance and withheld-score patterns are useful, but Finance already owns deterministic receipts and factory trajectory evidence.
